posting.title: Technical Content Delivery Manager
posting.descriptionPlain:
Who We Are
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.
We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.
About the Role
As a Technical Content Delivery Manager on the Solutions Engineering (SE) Enablement team, you will drive the platform strategy, content curation, and discoverability architecture for technical enablement assets across the global SE organization. In this role, you will report directly to the Director of Solutions Engineering Enablement and own the end-to-end administration and data organization structure of our Learning Management System (LMS) powered by HighSpot.
You will bridge the gap between complex product engineering and field readiness, leveraging a strong understanding of Verkada's physical security platform to design intuitive content hierarchies. By collaborating with IT/Data teams on AI best practices, you will optimize semantic searchability while owning the advanced analytics, feedback loops, and deprecation workflows necessary to maintain a pristine, high-impact technical repository.
What You'll Do
LMS Data Architecture & Ownership: Manage and optimize the HighSpot LMS as the "single source of truth" for the global SE organization. Design, implement, and govern the foundational data organization and folder structure, ensuring it aligns logically with Verkada’s product matrix (Command, Cameras, Access Control, Environmental Sensors, Alarms, Workplace, Intercom, and Audio).
Multi-Tiered Learning Delivery: Structure, tag, and deliver targeted content across three primary learning modalities to support the entire SE lifecycle:
Onboarding (New Learn): Curate foundational technical paths to accelerate time-to-productivity for new hires.
Continuous Education (Re-Learn): Maintain accessible skill-refresher materials and technical deep-dives to support ongoing technical mastery.
Just-In-Time Learning: Architect high-velocity, deal-specific content frameworks that allow SEs to instantly surface technical proof points required for upcoming customer meetings or field events.
AI Collaboration & Search Optimization: Partner with internal IT and Data teams to implement AI best practices, automated tagging, and semantic search configurations within HighSpot. Ensure technical documentation, demo scripts, and training assets are contextually discoverable based on real-time field queries.
Advanced Content Analytics & Reporting: Own the metrics, reporting dashboards, and performance analysis for all LMS content. Actively track search behavior, content consumption, and asset utilization to highlight highly utilized, high-benefit material to leadership while identifying operational skill gaps.
Content Lifecycle & Feedback Governance: Establish and execute a strict deprecation workflow to regularly remove outdated assets and prevent stale information from circulating in the field. Implement and manage a structured field feedback mechanism, including:
Instant Signaling: A thumbs up/down framework for real-time validation of content applicability.
Formal Correction Pipelines: A closed-loop triage process for the field to flag, review, and execute content updates regarding grammatical errors and technical accuracy.
What You Bring
Required
5+ years of combined experience in Technical Enablement, Content Management, or Content Architecture within enterprise SaaS, IoT, hardware, or networking industries.
Strong technical foundation in cloud networking, enterprise IT infrastructure, and physical security platform architecture to understand and categorize technical subject matter effectively.
Direct, hands-on experience administering enterprise content management repositories or LMS platforms (HighSpot experience highly preferred).
Proven track record collaborating with IT, data science, or engineering teams to leverage AI analytics, conversation intelligence, or semantic search optimization.
Demonstrated capability building data schemas, document classification frameworks, evaluation rubrics, and highly organized visual hierarchies.
Exceptional cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to serve as the structured voice-of-the-field, managing feedback loops and change management protocols across technical teams.
US Employee Benefits
Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:
Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
Expanded mental health support
Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time
Professional development stipend
Wellness/fitness benefits
Healthy lunches provided daily
Commuter benefits
Additional Information
You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time
Annual Pay Range
At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)
Below is the annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position, comprised of base compensation and commissions (if applicable).
Estimated Annual Pay Range
$150,000—$185,000 USD
Verkada Is An Equal Opportunity Employer
As an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Verkada will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.
Your application will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.
